description: GLM-4.6 analyst paper-trading performance export (read-only, regenerated by scripts/export_glm_paper_performance.ts)

forwardOutcomeTracker.policy: outcomes mature only after the required number of ACTUAL market sessions from the entry bar (Task 114 engine, per-symbol OhlcvBar dates); early SL/TP3 exits are separate measurements; no win rate, expectancy or probability calibration is reported (calibration requires >=100 matured LLM-cohort outcomes)

glmAttributionRule: recordType=="REAL_LLM_DECISION" AND provider=="zai" AND model=="glm-4.6"; MOCK_PIPELINE_CHECK (provider "mock") never counted in metrics

winRate.reason: Zero matured GLM-cohort outcomes. The platform's own forward-outcome tracker (task112_llm_pending_outcomes.json) reports matured_observations=0 and its policy forbids win-rate reporting before >=100 matured LLM-cohort outcomes. HOLD/NO_TRADE decisions are research positions, never trades, and are excluded.

grossPnl.reason: No GLM trade was ever entered or exited; no realized gross P&L record exists in any table (ProspectivePaperTrade has 0 GLM rows, PaperTradeLeg 0 rows, Trade 0 rows).

transactionCosts.reason: No executed GLM trade exists, so no realized cost was incurred. PLANNED cost scenarios per decision exist in riskReward.costsAtTp2 (reported separately).

netPnl.reason: No executed GLM trade exists; realized net P&L cannot be computed.

netRoi.reason: No executed GLM trade exists; realized ROI cannot be computed.

profitFactor.reason: Requires matured wins and losses; zero matured GLM outcomes exist.

averageWin.reason: Requires matured eligible wins; the GLM cohort has zero matured outcomes (forward-outcome tracker: matured_observations=0), so an average win does not exist.

averageLoss.reason: Requires matured eligible losses; the GLM cohort has zero matured outcomes (forward-outcome tracker: matured_observations=0), so an average loss does not exist.

maxDrawdown.reason: Requires a chronological realized-equity series; no GLM trade was ever settled, so no equity points exist.

unrealizedPnlOpenPositions.reason: The GLM cohort never entered positions (researchStatus=research_only on every record); there are no open GLM positions and no mark-to-market can exist. Planned TP/stop scenarios are reported separately.

plannedScenarioEconomics.note: WHAT-IF figures computed by the platform's risk engine from 2026-11-03/2025-01-03 evidence (executionAssumption=next_session_open_reference). These are PLANNED scenarios, not outcomes; they are never counted as wins, losses or P&L.
